description: `\overload` takes an optional declaration, which must stay with the command instead of being promoted to the brief -- the entity's own summary is the `\brief` beside it. Nothing renders `custom`, so the declaration is dropped from the page, which is what Doxygen does with it too.
raw:
/**
 * @overload void spin(int turns)
 * @brief Spins the widget the given number of turns.
 */

expected.brief: Spins the widget the given number of turns.
